{{Quote|Colonel Jadick, Imperial Reclamation Service reporting. We've encountered a first-contact scenario with a primeval species.|Jadick, upon meeting an Empire-aligned individual|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Jadick''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the time of the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed above the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'', he received the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave's]] [[Administrator General]] [[Lalat'k]] who told Jadick about the [[Hypergate]] crisis on [[Asation]]. Through the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[AD-304]], Jadick invited Imperial heroes to meet Lalat'k, so that they could assist with the [[Raid on Asation|operation]] on Asation.<ref name="TOR" />
